name: tr_fred
caption:
IF FRED HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐶 Lillipup: faces strong opponents with great courage. Undrafted in 2016, signed by us, a 905 champion in 2017
👶 Kangaskhan: never gives up a fight to protect its young. Son born mid-series, then 14-of-17 from three to close the East finals
🔮 Gothitelle: its ability is literally called Shadow Tag. Our box-and-one on Steph Curry in the Finals
🐕 Herdier: very loyal. Re-signed with us in 2020 for 4 years, $85 million, the biggest deal an undrafted player had ever signed
🌊 Kyogre: brings torrential downpours. 54 points and 11 threes in 2021, our franchise record
🏆 Stoutland: intelligent, good-natured and valiant. 22 off the bench in Finals Game 6, then an All-Star in 2022

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Fred VanVleet had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF FRED HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Lillipup. It faces strong opponents with great courage. Nobody drafted Fred in twenty sixteen. We signed him, and he won a title with our G League team.
beats.dlg: FACES STRONG FOES BRAVELY.|UNDRAFTED. SIGNED BY US.

beats.vo: Kangaskhan. To protect its young, it never gives up a fight. Before his son was born, Fred was six of forty-two. After: fourteen of seventeen from three to close the conference finals.
beats.dlg: IT FIGHTS FOR ITS YOUNG.|THEN: 14-OF-17 FROM 3!

beats.vo: Gothitelle. Its ability is literally called Shadow Tag: you can't escape it. In the Finals we ran a box-and-one, and Fred was Steph Curry's shadow.
beats.dlg: ITS ABILITY: SHADOW TAG.|FRED SHADOWED STEPH CURRY

beats.vo: Herdier. A very loyal monster. In twenty twenty Fred stayed: four years, eighty-five million, the biggest deal an undrafted player had ever signed.
Kyogre. It brings torrential downpours. February twenty twenty-one: fifty-four points, eleven threes. Our franchise record.
beats.dlg: IT BRINGS DOWNPOURS.|54 PTS + 11 THREES: RECORD

beats.vo: And the ace. Stoutland. Intelligent and valiant. Game six of the Finals: twenty-two off the bench. Twenty twenty-two: the undrafted kid is an All-Star.
beats.dlg: VALIANT AND BIG-HEARTED.|G6: 22 PTS. THEN ALL-STAR!

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: VanVleet went undrafted in the 2016 NBA draft and signed with Toronto; member of Raptors 905's 2017 championship team; shot 6-42 (3-24 from three) in 9 playoff games before his son was born May 20, 2019, then 14-17 on threes in the final three games of the East finals; box-and-one defense on Stephen Curry in the Finals; Game 6 of the Finals: playoff career-high 22 points with five threes off the bench; November 2020 re-signed for four (4) years, $85 million, the largest ever for an undrafted free agent at the time; February 2, 2021: 54 points with 11 threes, a franchise record; NBA All-Star 2022
